mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate compresses discount rates and stimulates equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days. This mechanism is active during monetary easing cycles.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in unemployment rate signals deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE increases by >0.2pp over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate a broad-based demand contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline by >0.5% from their 3-month averages.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production during late-cycle expansion signals an impending economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances during late-cycle expansion when INDPRO declines.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp monthly decline in non-farm payrolls signals immediate labor market weakness, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances when PAYEMS declines by >0.5% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in housing starts and retail sales over the past 3 months signal a sustained demand slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline by >0.5% from their 3-month averages.

mechanism_narrative: A rising federal funds rate during monetary tightening cycles compresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances during monetary tightening cycles when FEDFUNDS is rising.

mechanism_narrative: A declining trend in industrial production consistently leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days, regardless of broader economic regime.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO is declining.
